key_impacts: Over 1.3 million people evacuated in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh before landfall.
21 deaths due to the cyclone; subsequent floods caused 23 deaths in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh.
Peak wind gust of 185 kph recorded at Gopalpur.
18 districts in Odisha and 3 districts in Andhra Pradesh were affected.
National highways and key roads were closed; helicopters used for rescue and evacuations.
evidence_snippets: On 12th October 2013, Phailin Cyclone crossed the coastline… south of the city of Brahmapur in Odisha.
Gopalpur observed a gust of 185 kph at the storm’s northern eyewall.
…18 districts in Odisha and 3 districts in Andhra Pradesh affected… over 13 lakh people evacuated… 21 deaths; subsequent floods claimed 23 (Odisha) and 1 (A.P.).
missing_information: Exact list of affected districts not provided.
